info.title: Thrivea Public API
info.description:
Thrivea's public REST API: a customer's own systems read and write their Thrivea data.

### Basics
| | |
|---|---|
| **Base path** | `/v1` |
| **Media type** | `application/json` |
| **Auth** | `Authorization: Bearer <API key>` |

### Authentication
An API key is created in Thrivea and carries the scopes it was granted. Send it as a bearer token on
every call. A key acts within its own workspace only.

### Lists and pagination
A list is `{ "object": "list", "data": [...], "has_more": true|false, "url": "..." }`. Page with
`limit` and the id of the last item you hold in `starting_after` (or the first in `ending_before`).

### Errors
A failed call answers with an HTTP status and `{ "error": { "type": "...", "message": "...", "param": "...", "request_id": "..." } }`.
`type` is the stable value to branch on: `invalid_request_error` (400), `authentication_error` (401),
`permission_error` (403), `resource_missing` (404), `conflict_error` (409), `rate_limit_error` (429),
`api_error` (5xx). `message` is for people and logs.

### Request ids
Every answer carries a `Request-Id` header, and every error body the same value as `request_id`. Quote it
to Thrivea support and we find the call in our logs.

### Idempotency
A `POST`, `PATCH` or `PUT` may carry an `Idempotency-Key` header (1 to 255 characters of your choosing).
The first 2xx answer to a key is kept for 24 hours and replayed to a retry with the same key, with
`Idempotent-Replayed: true`, so a client that timed out and retried never creates twice. The same key with a
different request is a 400; the same key while the first request is still running is a 409. The key is
scoped to your API key.

### Rate limits
Requests are counted per API key in a fixed window. Every answer says where you stand: `RateLimit-Limit`,
`RateLimit-Remaining`, `RateLimit-Reset` (seconds until the window ends) and `RateLimit-Policy`
(`600;w=60`). Over the limit the answer is 429 `rate_limit_error` with `Retry-After`; wait that long.

Request-Id.description: The request's id, to quote to Thrivea support; the same value is in every error body as request_id.

RateLimit-Limit.description: How many requests this API key may make per window.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: How many of them are left in the current window.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the window ends and the count starts over.

RateLimit-Policy.description: The limit and the window, as `600;w=60`.
